newsitem.title: USA: Zeneca wins 94 pct acceptance on Mogen offer.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca wins 94 pct acceptance on Mogen offer.

text.p: Zeneca Agrochemicals said on Tuesday that it had concluded its public offer for Mogen International NV and had obtained acceptance representing 94 percent of the biotechnology company's shares.
In addition, Zeneca Agrochemicals, part of Zeneca Group Plc, said it will offer to purchase the remainder of Mogen shares at the offer price of GBP 4.31 per share until July 1.
According to the current offering price, Mogen is valued at GBP 44.5 million.
"We look forward to Mogen playing an important part in Zeneca's plant science business," said Zeneca Agrochemicals research director David Evans.
